tonal_mismatches.line_excerpt: He handed Judas the sop — a piece of dipped bread. "That thou doest, do quickly."
tonal_mismatches.rationale: The line's own content describes urgency ('do quickly', 'went immediately out'); [deliberate] signals slow/measured pacing, which works against that — better to let natural cadence carry here rather than fight the text.

concerns: That same beat (paragraph 4) spans two different emotional registers — the brisk dismissal ('do quickly') and the quiet finality of 'and it was night' — under one tag-set applied to the whole paragraph; current tooling tags per-paragraph only, so this shift has no way to register mid-beat
Tag variety is good (6 unique tags, none over 50% usage) and the single 3-tag beat is correctly reserved for the piece's actual rhetorical peak (paragraph 5)
